_about: John Bradford (c.1510-1555), Prebendary of St Paul's, martyr. Named john-bradford so William Bradford of Plymouth cannot collide. The target is the Parker Society Writings, ed. Aubrey Townsend (2 vols, Cambridge 1848 and 1853), Internet Archive OCR, raw; each title page read. Clean text alongside from CCEL: Godly Meditations upon the Lord's Prayer, and Sermons and Tracts.

bradford-ps-02: Writings of John Bradford: Letters, Treatises, Remains, ed. Aubrey Townsend (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1853), vol. 2
